اعتصرتم (form VIII)
# اِعْتَصَرْتُمْ (iʕtaṣartum) /iʕ.ta.sˤar.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِعْتَصَرَ (iʕtaṣara)
# اُعْتُصِرْتُمْ (uʕtuṣirtum) /uʕ.tu.sˤir.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِعْتَصَرَ (iʕtaṣara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
